investments.introHeading: Uzbekistan — one of the most dynamic economies in Eurasia
investments.intro1: Since 2017, Uzbekistan has undergone one of the most significant economic transformations in Eurasia. Liberalization of the foreign exchange market, tax and judicial reforms, capital market development, and privatization have transformed a previously closed economy into one of the region's most dynamic investment destinations. Today, it is the largest market in Central Asia by population, with approximately 37.7 million people and steadily growing domestic demand.
investments.intro2: 2025 reaffirmed this trajectory. GDP growth reached 7.7%, exceeding most forecasts; inflation declined to 7.3%, while unemployment fell to 4.8%. Fitch upgraded the sovereign rating to BB for the first time in seven years, S&P reaffirmed its BB rating, and Moody's maintained Ba3 while improving the outlook to positive. The country's accession process to the World Trade Organization is nearing completion, marking the most significant structural opening of the economy since the currency liberalization reforms of 2017.

ficHistory.p1: The Foreign Investors Council under the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan is an institutional platform for direct dialogue between the Government of Uzbekistan and investors operating in the country. It was established by Presidential Resolution No. PP-4519 dated November 13, 2019.
ficHistory.p2: The Council's activities are aimed at identifying key obstacles to attracting investment, developing solutions jointly with government bodies to eliminate them, and ensuring a favorable investment climate. The Chair of the Council is the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan; the Co-Chair is the President of the EBRD.

legalBasis.title: Legal Basis and Institutional Status
legalBasis.p1: The Foreign Investors Council under the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan was established by Presidential Resolution No. PP-4519 dated November 13, 2019 as a consultative and advisory body for direct dialogue between foreign investors, international financial institutions and the Government of the Republic of Uzbekistan.
legalBasis.p2: As the Council's activities expanded, the need arose for a permanently functioning operational body. By Presidential Resolution No. PP-226 dated July 18, 2025, the proposal of the Council members and international financial institutions to establish the Secretariat of the Council in the form of a non-governmental non-profit organization was supported.
legalBasis.p3: In execution of this resolution, on November 4, 2025, the Association of Legal Entities (Association, Union) "Foreign Investors Council", TIN 312 551 219, was registered — a legal entity performing the functions of the Secretariat of the Council.

secretariatPage.subtitle: The permanently operating body of the Foreign Investors Council
secretariatPage.missionText: The Secretariat of the Foreign Investors Council is a permanently functioning operational body that ensures the continuity and consistency of the Council's work between sessions. The Secretariat organizes plenary and interim meetings, coordinates the activities of the sixteen working groups, maintains a daily dialogue with Council members and foreign investors, collects and analyzes initiatives to improve the investment climate, and ensures their advancement into the relevant state policy.
secretariatPage.legalText: With the acquisition of legal entity status, the Secretariat gained the institutional autonomy necessary to effectively fulfil its mandate and to engage with international financial institutions.

s1.title: First plenary session of the Foreign Investors Council
s1.cardTitle: First plenary session of the Foreign Investors Council, November 16, 2022
paragraphs: On November 16, 2022, the first plenary session of the Foreign Investors Council was held at the Kuksaroy residence in Tashkent, under the chairmanship of the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan. The session opened an institutional format for direct dialogue between the Government and international investors.
More than 150 high-level representatives participated in the session — international financial institutions, leading industrial and investment companies, ministries and agencies.
Discussions covered improving the business environment, stability of the tax and legal system, development of public-private partnerships, green economy, and digital transformation.
As a result of the session, more than 40 specific proposals and initiatives were developed, launching the Council's systematic work.

s2.title: Second plenary session of the Foreign Investors Council
s2.cardTitle: Second plenary session of the Foreign Investors Council, May 3, 2024
paragraphs: On May 3, 2024, within the framework of the III Tashkent International Investment Forum, the second plenary session of the Foreign Investors Council was held under the chairmanship of the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan. The session consolidated the transition from developing proposals to their systematic implementation.
Following the session, Presidential Decree No. PP-179 of May 15, 2024 was adopted, approving a roadmap of 14 initiatives.

These include new editions of the laws on investments and special economic zones, a law on alternative (venture) investments, implementation of the OECD Investment Policy Review project, and the establishment of four Council working groups on key areas.

s3.title: Third plenary session of the Foreign Investors Council
s3.cardTitle: Third plenary session of the Foreign Investors Council, June 11, 2025
paragraphs: International Congress Centre, under the chairmanship of the President and with the participation of the EBRD President. Over 40 initiatives were selected; basic tax rates for businesses will remain unchanged until 2028. As a result — PP-226 of 18.07.2025 (entered into force on 21.07.2025).

On June 11, 2025, the third plenary session of the Foreign Investors Council was held at the International Congress Center under the chairmanship of the President of the Republic of Uzbekistan and with the participation of the EBRD President. The session was attended by heads of Masdar, ACWA, Indorama, Vision Invest, DataVolt, VEON, Boeing, SpaceX, Meta, Franklin Templeton, TotalEnergies and other companies, as well as representatives of the OECD, IFC, ADB and the Islamic Development Bank.

The effectiveness of the platform was highlighted: the EBRD invested a record amount of approximately $1 billion in Uzbekistan over the year, becoming the country's largest partner in the region; the volume of joint projects with the private sector exceeded $1 billion; leading energy companies invested over $8 billion in the green economy.
It was announced that basic tax rates for business will not change until 2028; over two years, 5,500 new enterprises with foreign capital were established, bringing the total to 16,000.

More than 40 initiatives were selected for the session. Following the session, Presidential Decree No. PP-226 of July 18, 2025 was adopted, approving the roadmap and formalizing the transformation of the Council Secretariat into an independent legal entity.

wg.johnZaidiText: John Zaidi has over 25 years of experience in taxation, energy development, and investment infrastructure. He actively participates in promoting energy projects, introducing new technologies, and strengthening Uzbekistan's energy sector. He is a member of the Association of the Council of Foreign Investors of Kazakhstan and represents ACWA in the European Energy Companies Association. Previously, he worked in leading international energy corporations, including projects in the USA and Europe.
wg.spartakPos: Chairman of the Board, TBC Bank Uzbekistan
wg.spartakText: Chairman of the Board of TBC Bank Uzbekistan, having taken office in December 2020. In Uzbekistan, Tetrashvili has a non-trivial and ambitious task: to establish TBC Bank Uzbekistan, the first fully digital bank in Uzbekistan, where there is not a single process behind which a person stands, and all services can be obtained through the application. Spartak believes that the TBC brand philosophy is about creating transparent, accessible and bold solutions.
wg.sandroPos: General Director of Ipoteka Bank OTP Group
wg.sandroText: Sandro Rtveladze is the General Director of Ipoteka Bank OTP Group. He has extensive experience in banking and financial sector management, having led major transformation initiatives at one of Uzbekistan's leading mortgage banks. Under his leadership, Ipoteka Bank has significantly expanded its retail and corporate banking services, driving digital transformation and strengthening partnerships with international financial institutions. Sandro actively contributes to talent development policy within the FIC working group, focusing on attracting qualified international professionals and building local human capital capacity.
wg.sergeyText: Sergey Salikov — Uzum, General Counsel. Has over 12 years of experience supporting investment agreements, creating funds and holdings in various jurisdictions. He headed the legal block at the Russian Direct Investment Fund and was among those who supported M&A projects at Gazprombank.
wg.gayanaPos: Chairman of the Foundation for the Development of Culture and Arts of Uzbekistan under the Cabinet of Ministers
wg.gayanaText: Chairman of the Foundation for the Development of Culture and Arts of Uzbekistan under the Cabinet of Ministers of the Republic of Uzbekistan. Secretary General of the National Commission of Uzbekistan for UNESCO. Graduated from the School of Integrated Arts (West Yorkshire) in 2004 and Westminster International University in 2008 with a degree in Business Management. Has a Master's degree in Contemporary Art and Art Business from the University of Manchester.
wg.erlanPos: EY, Managing Partner for the Caucasus and Central Asia
wg.erlanText: Erlan has over 25 years of experience in local and international taxation, tax efficiency, tax disputes and tax risk management. Erlan actively participates in projects to improve the business climate and investment attractiveness, oversees projects for the development of the institutional environment, infrastructure, decarbonization and clean technologies. He is Chairman of the Board of the Association 'Kazakhstan Council of Foreign Investors' and the European Business Association in Kazakhstan.
wg.lazizPos: Minister of Investments, Industry and Trade
wg.lazizBio: Laziz Kudratov has been the Minister of Investments, Industry and Trade of the Republic of Uzbekistan since December 2022. He has extensive experience in foreign economic relations and investment, holding important positions at the Ministry of Foreign Economic Relations, Investments and Trade and at the Embassy of Uzbekistan in the USA. Under his leadership, strategic reforms are being implemented aimed at increasing the country's investment attractiveness, developing industry, and stimulating foreign trade. By actively participating in international initiatives, the Minister contributes to Uzbekistan's integration into the global economy and strengthens its position in the global market.
wg.kazbekPos: Vision Invest Senior Vice President and Head of Representative Office in Uzbekistan
wg.kazbekBio: Kazbek Bassiyev is the senior vice president of Vision Invest and head of this company's representative office in Uzbekistan. He holds the position of Deputy Chairman of the Working Group, which indicates his important role in coordinating projects and interaction with government structures in the field of public-private partnership and investment. Vision Invest is a large infrastructure holding with assets in energy, water supply, construction, and transport, actively operating in Uzbekistan and Saudi Arabia. Bassiyev participates in the discussion and implementation of promising investment projects that contribute to the development of the country's economy and infrastructure.
wg.timurPos: Chairman of the Central Bank of the Republic of Uzbekistan
wg.timurBio: Timur Ishmetov has served as Chairman of the Central Bank of the Republic of Uzbekistan since December 2024. He has more than 19 years of experience in the banking sector, having held key positions at the Central Bank and the Ministry of Finance. Under his leadership, reforms are being implemented to increase the transparency, efficiency, and sustainable development of the country's financial system.
wg.davronBio: Davron Yakubov is the Managing Partner of BDO Uzbekistan. He has extensive experience in audit and consulting, both in the local market and in international practice. Under his leadership, the company provides professional services in audit, tax advisory, and business consulting, helping to strengthen corporate governance standards in the country.
wg.veraBio: Vera Bell is the Managing Partner of Crowe Uzbekistan. She has significant international experience working in the United Kingdom, EU countries, and Central Asia. Under her leadership, Crowe Uzbekistan provides professional audit, consulting, and financial advisory services, partnering with major international and national companies.
wg.kongratbayPos: Minister of Higher Education, Science and Innovation, Head of the Working Group
wg.kongratbayBio: Kongratbay Sharipov serves as Minister of Higher Education, Science and Innovation of the Republic of Uzbekistan. He holds a doctorate in technical sciences and is a professor with extensive management experience in education and science, including leading the Tashkent Institute of Architecture and Civil Engineering. Under his leadership, the ministry is implementing reforms aimed at developing the personnel training system and introducing innovation into the educational process.
wg.ilkhomPos: First Deputy Minister of Economy and Finance
wg.ilkhomBio: Ilkhom Norkulov serves as First Deputy Minister of Economy and Finance of the Republic of Uzbekistan. He has extensive experience in the economic sector, including senior positions at the Central Bank. Since February 2023, he has led work on economic development, tax incentives, and combating the shadow economy.
wg.mariusPos: CEO of Franklin Templeton for Central Asia
wg.mariusBio: Marius Dan serves as CEO of Franklin Templeton for Central Asia. In this role, he oversees the management of the National Investment Fund of Uzbekistan (UzNIF) and the development of the company's investment strategies in the region. Under his leadership, Franklin Templeton is actively working to attract international investors and prepare UzNIF for listing on stock exchanges.
wg.ahadbekPos: Deputy Minister of Economy and Finance, Head of the Working Group
wg.ahadbekBio: Ahadbek Haydarov is an experienced specialist in public policy, macroeconomics, and financial management. Before his appointment to the Ministry of Economy and Finance, he held senior positions in state asset management and the banking and financial sectors. Since 2019, he has served as Deputy Minister of Economy and Finance, overseeing the state budget and economic development.
wg.farrukhBio: Farrukh Pulatov has served as Director of the Cadastre Agency under the State Tax Committee of the Republic of Uzbekistan since March 2022. He holds higher education in engineering and law and has extensive management experience, having previously headed the company Uzdonmahsulot. Under his leadership, the agency is implementing reforms to digitize land and property records.
wg.azizbekAkhmadjonovPos: Managing Partner of Kosta Legal, Deputy Head of the Working Group
wg.azizbekAkhmadjonovBio: Azizbek Akhmadjonov is the Managing Partner of Kosta Legal, one of Uzbekistan's leading law firms. He has extensive experience in real estate, construction, corporate law, and litigation. Akhmadjonov actively participates in reforming Uzbekistan's legal system, particularly in regulating the legal profession and attracting foreign investment.
wg.jurabekPos: Minister of Energy, Head of the Working Group
wg.jurabekBio: Jurabek Mirzamahmudov has headed the Ministry of Energy of the Republic of Uzbekistan since 2022 and is responsible for the strategic development of the sector, the introduction of innovation, and the implementation of major investment projects in the energy industry. He has significant experience in nuclear, renewable, and conventional energy, and promotes international cooperation and the integration of modern technologies.
wg.azizAbdukhakimovPos: Chairman of the National Committee for Ecology and Climate Change, Head of the Working Group
wg.azizAbdukhakimovBio: Aziz Abdukhakimov is the Chairman of the State Committee for Ecology and Climate Change. He has many years of experience in public administration, tourism, and ecology, having served at different times as Deputy Prime Minister responsible for tourism development. Under his leadership, systematic reforms are being implemented for environmental protection and climate change mitigation.
wg.kazumasaPos: General Manager of Coca-Cola Uzbekistan, Deputy Head of the Working Group
wg.kazumasaBio: Kazumasa Mukae is the General Manager of Coca-Cola Bottlers Uzbekistan. He has extensive experience in the beverage industry and international company management, playing a key role in developing the company's operations in Uzbekistan. Under his leadership, initiatives are being implemented to improve production efficiency and promote sustainable development.
wg.olimjonBio: Olimjon Umarov is the Deputy Minister of Digital Technologies. He has many years of experience in information policy, mass communications, and digital development, having held senior positions in public administration. Under his leadership, initiatives are being put forward to increase the transparency of government bodies and introduce modern information technologies.
